basic_info.chief_complaint: The upper right front tooth is knocked loose.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: The upper right front tooth is knocked loose.

present_illness.present_illness: The patient reported that the upper right front door became loose and shifted due to collision an hour ago. He reset it on his own and later went to our hospital for treatment.

past_history.present_illness: The patient reported that the upper right front door became loose and shifted due to collision an hour ago. He reset it on his own and later went to our hospital for treatment.

oral_examination.oral_examination: Lateral cracks appeared in the crown, no loosening was found in the crown, and the entire tooth was loosened to 1 degree. Percussion ( ), the periodontal ligament was bleeding, and the remaining teeth need to be checked.

treatment_plan.definitive: First, perform conservative treatment with ligation and fixation for one month. If pulpal symptoms occur subsequently, RCT will be performed.

source_handle: The patient explained the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. The patient informed and agreed to the treatment and signed an informed consent form. 11, 12, and 21 tooth surfaces are etched and then adhesive is applied. Fixed with ligature wire.
